name: Soul of Adalis (Soulknife Archetype)
body:
Souls of Adalis are a band of soulknives who keep their skills sharp by harnessing the power of ancient relics. This allows the soulknives to shape their weapons to mimic the relics at the cost of some of their other abilities and talents.

Form Relic (Su)

Each time a soul of Adalis forms her mind blade, she can give it the form of one of the relics, instead of its usual form.

If the soulknife’s chosen form is the shield of Adalis, she may choose to also form a one-handed weapon to wield alongside it.

This weapon functions like a standard mind blade.

A soul of Adalis’ relic functions as it would normally for a creature her size (the axe and bow each deal 1d10 damage if she’s Medium, and so on). The soulknife does not modify the damage or the critical threat range (except on the weapon formed with the shield of Adalis). She can still choose mind blade with feats like Weapon Focus and apply those benefits to her relic, as appropriate.

At 1st level, relics formed by a soul of Adalis have no magical properties other than to provide DR against a specific damage type, as determined by her current relic. Beginning at 6th level, the soul of Adalis can choose one of her relic’s forms and gain its full benefits (other than the enhancement bonus, which is still based on enhanced mind blade). She gains this benefit with another relic at 12th level, and the final relic at 18th level. She can use shape mind blade to change which of her relics benefit her as if reassigning abilities.

This ability alters form mind blade and replaces throw mind blade and the blade skills gained at 6th, 12th, and 18th level.
